newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CEPA output to beat China Light by 2000.
newsitem.headline: CEPA output to beat China Light by 2000.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd said on Friday it expected its 20-percent-held Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd 0166.HK (CEPA) to have overtaken China Light & Power Co Ltd by 2000 in electricity output.

"We expect by the year 2000, we (CEPA) will have overtaken China Light & Power," Hopewell executive director Robert Niem told a news conference when he presented a chart showing the two companies' electricity output in past years.
CEPA is a power producer in Asia. China Light is a major electricity supplier in Hong Kong.
